retrievalProfile.description: A centered, realistic infant or doll wearing oversized studio headphones against a vibrant, flat red backdrop with distressed grunge typography.
triggerTerms: baby wearing headphones on red background
excludeWhen: clean corporate sans-serif typography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a seated infant (or lifelike doll) wearing large, silver-and-black over-ear headphones. The subject is centered against a saturated red field. A black coiled cable extends from the headphones across the bottom foreground. Above the subject, heavy, distressed black lettering provides a gritty, industrial contrast to the smooth subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically and horizontally against a flat color field
Coiled cable creates a horizontal leading line at the base
Distressed display type anchored at the top center
High-key studio lighting on the subject creates soft shadows on the red floor
coreInvariants: Oversized studio-style headphones on a small subject
Distressed, eroded texture on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Infant subject is centrally located, occupying approximately 50% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large silver earcups of the headphones serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the headphones, move down the baby's body to the coiled cable, then sweep up to the distressed header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive flat red negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with neutral-toned subject and high-contrast black accents.

letterConstructionRules: Eroded edges simulating ink bleed or stencil wear
Heavy vertical strokes with irregular terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'bitten' edges and internal speckling to mimic distressed print
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact distressed display paired with a clean, small-scale sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the eroded, industrial stencil look
Provides the necessary grit and heavy weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A realistic infant or lifelike doll sitting on a flat red surface, wearing large silver and black studio headphones. A black coiled cable runs from the headphones across the bottom of the frame. Studio lighting with soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, distressed black uppercase text at the top center. Add a smaller, clean black lowercase sans-serif subtitle aligned to the bottom right of the main text.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant red?
Is the main text visibly distressed and eroded?
Is the coiled cable present at the bottom?
Is the baby/doll wearing oversized headphones?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the infant

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is black and distressed.
Ensure the coiled cable is visible and realistic.
Verify the red background is uniform and saturated.
Confirm the subject is centered and in focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Realistic subject + oversized tech accessory + flat saturated background + distressed industrial typography.
